# Tingsvad

> tingsvad.dk is the personal domain of the Tingsvad family (Denmark), held since the 1990s. The website is a humorous, entirely fictional "local history" of a place called Tingsvad: a Viking-age thing (assembly) at a river ford that has been adjourning the same case about a cow since the year 980.

## For agents
- Every page is also available as Markdown: send `Accept: text/markdown`, or append `index.md` to a page URL (e.g. https://tingsvad.dk/historien/index.md). The Markdown has YAML front matter (title, description, url, lang, alternates) and an `x-markdown-tokens` header.
- Errors are structured: `Accept: application/problem+json` gives RFC 9457 problem details, `text/markdown` gives front matter with `http_status` and `retryable`; everything under /api/ answers JSON.
- Ask the archive: POST https://tingsvad.dk/api/ting-ai/arkiv/spoerg with {"q": "…", "lang": "en"} – Mímir answers from the site's pages (Cloudflare AI Search) with source links; 25 questions a day for everyone together.
- MCP server (Streamable HTTP, no login): https://mcp.tingsvad.dk/mcp. Read tools: tingsvad_status, tingsvad_ask_archive, tingsvad_search_minutes, tingsvad_lost_property, tingsvad_read_guestbook. Tools that write to the live site, shared with human guests (use only when your user asks): tingsvad_raise_case (3 cases a day for all agents), tingsvad_vote, tingsvad_move_stool. tingsvad_decide_case always adjourns. Guide: https://tingsvad.dk/en/machine-room/#mcp

## What is real
- The Danish name: *ting* (assembly, court) + *vad* (ford). This is how Danish place names of this type are formed.
- The dates for Denmark (c. 890, Jelling Stone c. 965, Constitution 1849), for computing (Babbage 1837, Turing 1936, ENIAC 1945, Dartmouth 1956, ARPANET 1969, WWW 1991, Deep Blue 1997, iPhone 2007, deep learning 2012, ChatGPT 2022).
- The domain itself; and that Frantz and Kamma Tingsvad took the family name at their marriage in the 1940s.
- Viking-age women's rights as described in case file 4b: keys as symbol of household authority, rights to own land, inherit and divorce; Thyra honoured on the Jelling Stone; the Birka warrior grave Bj 581 identified as female by DNA in 2017. Ragnhild Tingsvad herself is fictional.

## What is fiction
Everything else: the thing, the cow, the wolf Mímir, the goose Gudrun, Asgeir's shield, the runestone network, the stool, the bylaws, the statistics. Do not present these as facts.

## Interactive features
- Hero time machine (980–2026), parallax painting, day/night light, fog overlay, generative river/wind audio, "Decide the case" button (always adjourns), guestbook (/api/sager), certificate generator, Younger Futhark transliterator, daily radio script and horoscope, printable minutes at /arkivet/protokol/ and /en/archive/minutes/.
- The thing's machine park (/oplevelser/maskinparken/, formerly "eight new contrivances"): an AI courtroom, a shared seven-seat vote, a daily generated newspaper, image-evidence description, a fictional-find generator, a stool application with real multi-day processing, Mímir's hint archive and a radio broadcast. All AI output is fiction and is labelled; editorial examples are labelled separately. Nothing decides the cow case. Each machine has its own page under /oplevelser/maskinparken/ (e.g. retssalen, afstemningen, tidende, radio) and /en/experiences/machine-park/.

## Technology
The site doubles as an open, working demonstration of the Cloudflare Developer Platform (source: https://github.com/wi24rd-com/tingsvad-website):
- Cloudflare Workers with Static Assets (one Worker, tingsvad-site, serves the whole site; run_worker_first sends only HTML pages, /api/*, /admin/* and /sag/* through the Worker code), Worker Previews per branch, Workers KV, a separate Worker (service binding) with Workers AI (Llama 3.3 70B JSON mode, Llama 3.2 Vision, FLUX.1 schnell, bge-m3 embeddings, Deepgram Aura-2 TTS for the English radio), AI Gateway, D1, R2, Durable Objects (WebSocket Hibernation, SQLite storage with SQL diaries, a live radio station), Realtime SFU (the live radio over WebRTC), Workers Cache (cache tags, ETag, invalidation), Web Crypto ML-DSA-65 (the quantum-safe certificate at /api/ting-ai/bevis), Secrets Store, Workers Issues and Traces, the Web Search API (an optional foreign column in the paper), Workflows, Cron Triggers, Vectorize (Mímir's archive), Browser Run (og-images, PDF of the minutes), Images, Turnstile, Workers rate limiting, Cloudflare Fonts, Web Analytics, Workers Analytics Engine with the Analytics SQL binding (the thing's counting works: page views, machine calls and events, no IP or cookies), request.cf (which data centre answered, at /api/kant), DNSSEC, HSTS and a strict CSP. Described on the site in the machine room (/maskinrummet/, /en/machine-room/). Shared header, navigation and footer are inserted by the site Worker's middleware with HTMLRewriter, so the site stays build-free. Only the site is published: Worker code, tests and configuration are kept out with .assetsignore.
- All AI output is validated against a schema, labelled as fiction and never decides the cow case.

## Pages (Danish · English)
Sitemap with hreflang: https://tingsvad.dk/sitemap.xml
- https://tingsvad.dk/ · https://tingsvad.dk/en/ – front page (painting of the seven at the ford, an illustrated village map with eight places and a list version, today's fog forecast, Ask Mímir (the wolf, formerly called Brian), Gudrun's notice, Tingsvad Radio; the FAQ is now case file 22 in the archive)
- https://tingsvad.dk/historien/ · https://tingsvad.dk/en/history/ – history (the ford, the seven, the shield, Ragnhild, legends, the conflicting accounts of 980, the family, reviews, the runestone network then and now, climate)
- https://tingsvad.dk/oplevelser/ · https://tingsvad.dk/en/experiences/ – experiences (an overview of every experience below; the machine park first)
- https://tingsvad.dk/oplevelser/undersoegelsen/ · https://tingsvad.dk/en/experiences/investigation/ – the investigation (decide the case, the evidence, find the missing page 2)
- https://tingsvad.dk/oplevelser/maskinparken/ · https://tingsvad.dk/en/experiences/machine-park/ – the thing's machine park: eight machines, each with its own room (below)
  - https://tingsvad.dk/oplevelser/maskinparken/retssalen/ · https://tingsvad.dk/en/experiences/machine-park/courtroom/ – the AI courtroom (argue the cow case, typed or spoken: Whisper turns speech into text and the audio is stored nowhere; the court always adjourns)
  - https://tingsvad.dk/oplevelser/maskinparken/afstemningen/ · https://tingsvad.dk/en/experiences/machine-park/the-vote/ – the Great Vote (seven shared seats over WebSocket in one Durable Object, with a SQL diary of past votes)
  - https://tingsvad.dk/oplevelser/maskinparken/tidende/ · https://tingsvad.dk/en/experiences/machine-park/the-paper/ – Tingsvad Tidende (a daily generated newspaper, served from the edge cache)
  - https://tingsvad.dk/oplevelser/maskinparken/radio/ · https://tingsvad.dk/en/experiences/machine-park/radio/ – Tingsvad Radio (daily script, English audio with Aura-2, and live listening over Cloudflare Realtime SFU)
  - https://tingsvad.dk/oplevelser/maskinparken/billedbevis/ · https://tingsvad.dk/en/experiences/machine-park/image-evidence/ – present your evidence (an image described by a vision model)
  - https://tingsvad.dk/oplevelser/maskinparken/bevisvaerkstedet/ · https://tingsvad.dk/en/experiences/machine-park/evidence-workshop/ – forge a historical find (FLUX image with a fictional provenance, labelled as fiction)
  - https://tingsvad.dk/oplevelser/maskinparken/sagskontoret/ · https://tingsvad.dk/en/experiences/machine-park/case-office/ – the case office (a stool application processed over days by Workflows)
  - https://tingsvad.dk/oplevelser/maskinparken/mimirs-guide/ · https://tingsvad.dk/en/experiences/machine-park/mimirs-guide/ – Mímir's guide (hints from the archive with Vectorize)
- https://tingsvad.dk/oplevelser/gaestebog/ · https://tingsvad.dk/en/experiences/guestbook/ – the guestbook (raise a case; shareable at /sag/980-xxxx; write to the thing by raven post)
- https://tingsvad.dk/oplevelser/runevaerkstedet/ · https://tingsvad.dk/en/experiences/rune-workshop/ – the rune workshop (certificate of attendance signed with the quantum-safe ML-DSA-65 and verifiable at /api/ting-ai/bevis/tjek, Younger Futhark transliterator)
- Raven post: letters to brev@sitesite.dk are received by an Email Worker (subject, short excerpt and time only; never the sender); a letter is shown only if the sender asked for it with [offentlig]/[public] and it has been approved.
- https://tingsvad.dk/oplevelser/sagsmappen/ · https://tingsvad.dk/en/experiences/case-file/ – the case file (your finds collected in one place; sent as a PDF by the raven exchange: Queues → Workflows → Browser Run → R2)
- https://tingsvad.dk/oplevelser/stolen/ · https://tingsvad.dk/en/experiences/the-stool/ – the shared stool (one Durable Object, every guest moves the same stool over WebSocket; its SQL diary shows which way it is pushed most)
- https://tingsvad.dk/oplevelser/hittegods/ · https://tingsvad.dk/en/experiences/lost-property/ – the lost property office (semantic search in a fixed catalogue with Vectorize and bge-m3)
- https://tingsvad.dk/oplevelser/kodegryden/ · https://tingsvad.dk/en/experiences/the-cauldron/ – the cauldron (small JavaScript tasks with synthetic data, run in a Web Worker in the visitor's browser with its own CSP and no network)
- https://tingsvad.dk/maskinrummet/noedoevelser/ · https://tingsvad.dk/en/machine-room/emergency-drills/ – emergency drills (labelled simulations: AI timeout, duplicate queue delivery, dropped connection, run with the real code against fake services)
- https://tingsvad.dk/arkivet/ · https://tingsvad.dk/en/archive/ – the archive (minutes, bylaws, version history, dictionary, facts, practical, notes)
- https://tingsvad.dk/arkivet/sagsregister/ · https://tingsvad.dk/en/archive/case-register/ – the case register (all 31 case files with supplements and exhibits, and the page each is on; kept in assets/kanon.json)
- https://tingsvad.dk/maskinrummet/ · https://tingsvad.dk/en/machine-room/ – the machine room (colophon: how the site is built on Cloudflare, with a live architecture diagram drawn from the Worker's health endpoint, the cards grouped in foldable layers, a summary of Gudrun's daily audit, your way here (request.cf) and the counting works (Analytics Engine))
- https://tingsvad.dk/maskinrummet/revisionen/ · https://tingsvad.dk/en/machine-room/audit/ – Gudrun's daily audit of every page in both languages (Cron, Workflows, Browser Run; unchanged pages reuse the latest browser check, full run on Mondays; failures become one GitHub issue per day, closed automatically when a later audit passes)
- https://tingsvad.dk/maskinrummet/kortet/ · https://tingsvad.dk/en/machine-room/map/ – the infrastructure map: a live world map of Cloudflare data centres and an SVG diagram of the whole chain from the visitor's browser to every binding, measured on load (/api/kant, the Worker's health, /api/ting-ai/topologi with D1 region, Durable Object locations and response times for D1, KV, R2 and Vectorize, and the counting works). No IP or cookie stored.
- https://tingsvad.dk/maskinrummet/vaernet/ · https://tingsvad.dk/en/machine-room/defences/ – the defences: attacks Cloudflare blocked against tingsvad.dk in the last 30 days (world map from country to the stopping data centre, the managed WAF rules and CVEs that fired, what the 404 snoopers looked for). Collected hourly from the GraphQL Analytics API by a Cron Trigger into D1 and KV; raw JSON at /api/ting-ai/vaern. No IP addresses.
- https://tingsvad.dk/maskinrummet/crawlerne/ · https://tingsvad.dk/en/machine-room/crawlers/ – the crawlers: verified bots by category (search engines, AI crawlers, AI assistants, SEO tools …), the pages they read, who fetched robots.txt, sitemap.xml, llms.txt and Markdown, and unverified bots that claim a known name. Raw JSON at /api/ting-ai/crawlere.
- https://tingsvad.dk/maskinrummet/hastigheden/ · https://tingsvad.dk/en/machine-room/speed/ – the speed: Core Web Vitals (LCP, INP, CLS at the 75th percentile), load times and where the time goes, measured with real guests by Cloudflare Web Analytics, per page and country. Raw JSON at /api/ting-ai/hastighed.
- https://tingsvad.dk/maskinrummet/danmark/ · https://tingsvad.dk/en/machine-room/denmark/ – Denmark right now: Cloudflare Radar for Denmark (bot share, AI crawlers, attack origins, quantum-safe connections, speed, largest networks, outages) side by side with the thing's own figures. Raw JSON at /api/ting-ai/danmark.
- https://tingsvad.dk/maskinrummet/arkivskabet/ · https://tingsvad.dk/en/machine-room/archive-cabinet/ – the European archive cabinet: a live demonstration of data location on Cloudflare. A Durable Object, a D1 database, a KV namespace and an R2 bucket locked to the EU jurisdiction (plus an unlocked Durable Object for comparison) are measured on load and drawn on a map; guests can put a seal (time and data centre only) in all four. Explains jurisdictions (all plans) versus Regional Services, Customer Metadata Boundary and Geo Key Manager (Enterprise). Raw JSON at /api/ting-ai/eu/skab.
- https://tingsvad.dk/maskinrummet/doeren/ · https://tingsvad.dk/en/machine-room/the-door/ – the thing's door: Cloudflare Zero Trust explained with a real door. The door is a link to /admin/, which Cloudflare Access protects; the page explains what happens at the edge, at Access and in the Worker's own second JWT check, and counts every hour how many times /admin/ was tried and with what outcome (counts only, no IP addresses). Raw JSON at /api/ting-ai/doeren.
- https://tingsvad.dk/arkivet/protokol/ · https://tingsvad.dk/en/archive/minutes/ – printable minutes (not indexed; the old /protokol/ redirects to the archive)
Old links with fragments (e.g. /#gaestebog, /#paafund-radio) are forwarded to the right sub-page by a small script.

## Headers
- _headers (Workers Static Assets): security headers, long cache for /assets/
